title: Private customized walking tour of Charleston
requirements: Not recommended for travelers with spinal injuries
Travelers should have at least a moderate level of physical fitness
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Talk a walking tour of historic Charleston SC with a certified and licensed guide. See beautiful architecture in our homes, churches, and public buildings. Hear over 356 years of history from the founding of our colony through wars, natural disasters and more! Come learn about the ensalved and Gullah culture and places that make Charleston so unique! Tours can be customized based on the interests of your group!
